       '〜',
       (MIN(N2.num) - 1) AS gap_end
  FROM Numbers N1
       INNER JOIN Numbers N2
          ON N2.num > N1.num
 GROUP BY N1.num
HAVING (N1.num + 1) < MIN(N2.num)
 ORDER BY gap_start

       '〜',
       (num + diff - 1) AS gap_end
  FROM (SELECT num,
               MAX(num)
                 OVER (ORDER BY num
                        ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING
                                 AND 1 FOLLOWING) - num AS diff
          FROM Numbers) TMP
 WHERE diff <> 1
 ORDER BY gap_start
